column1: # Reference data mirrored into crates/panini-data/src/lib.rs's DHATUS table.
# Not parsed by any code in this repo.

# upadesha's initial z has already become s (and the retroflex w along with
# it), because no rule in the engine performs that substitution. This follows
# the file's existing convention of storing post-upadesha, it-stripped SLP1
# (e.g. vf for vfN), not a new liberty.
